messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P1 - networking anomaly detected for region azure-uknorth affecting Private/VPN-connected inference clusters (prod-inference). Alert triggered by packet-loss > 5% and 95th pct tail latency spike. Detected 2026-03-15T03:12:30Z. Initial affected customers: 3 enterprise tenants.

Alex P: paging @Priya K (oncall-sre) and @Maria G (net-eng). Can you confirm impact and start mitigation?

Priya K: ack — I’m oncall. Joining. Running quick checks now.

Priya K: `az network watcher show-next-hop --resource-id /subscriptions/REDACTED/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/vnet-uknorth --source 10.11.12.45` shows next-hop via circuit CRC1234 but multiple BGP updates in last 2m.

Maria G: I see BGP withdraws from Azure side for the ExpressRoute circuit. Azure metric shows flapping on peering -> vnet. Looks like path pref changed to a transitive carrier node, increased latency.

Alex P: customer impact: inference tail lat > 2s for private endpoints, some requests time out. Non-public (Private) routes only; hosted API unaffected.

Priya K: run `traceroute -n 10.11.12.1` from runner:```
traceroute to 10.11.12.1 (10.11.12.1), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1 10.0.0.1 1.1 ms
 2 52.120.45.1 16.2 ms
 3 100.64.12.77 150.3 ms
 4 52.120.46.9 380.6 ms 
 5 * * *
```
looks like an AS-level handoff at hop 3-4 with big jump.

NOC Bot: created INC-2026-4532, assigned to net-eng team. Azure SR opened (SR# 987654321).

Elena S: FYI circuit CRC1234 is on a partner-provisioned ExpressRoute. Partner portal shows intermittent carrier maintenance window at 03:00-03:30Z impacting uknorth POP cluster. Partner says partial route dampening applied.

Alex P: immediate mitigation options? Can we steer traffic to an alternate route/region for private tenants?

Priya K: Yes — initiating smart-routing failover for affected route prefix to prefer azure-westeurope path (region fallback) via our control plane. Will do a canary 20% -> 50% -> 100% if stable. Command: `POST /internal/routing/engineer/steer` payload: `{ "prefix": "10.11.12.0/24", "preference": "westeurope", "canary_pct": 20 }` (internal only).

Maria G: before full cut, we should ensure KV cache warming on target region. Starting cache pre-warm for affected model-serving pools in westeurope.

Priya K: canary now at 20% -> monitoring. Metrics: request latency for canary below 300ms so far, error rate 0.4% vs 6% on uknorth.

Jorge L: tagging this for customer comms. @Elena S can you confirm which tenants require legal notif for route change?

Elena S: two enterprise tenants on dedicated circuits require in-band notice. I’m preparing a short status note: impacted resources, mitigation in progress, expected minutes for stable route.

SRE Ops: adding a temporary fallback rule to serve from dedicated capacity pool in westeurope for token-heavy paths (low-latency critical customers). Will monitor cost impact.

Priya K: Azure SR responded — partner confirmed transient dampening, they initiated suppressed route removal. They estimate full restoration in 15-25m.

Alex P: good. Keep rolling the canary up to 50% once metrics hold for 5m. Post the checkpoint results here.

Priya K: canary -> 50% at 03:24:50Z. Latency stable, errors down. Raising to 100% at 03:29:10Z.

IncidentBot: note — all user-facing private endpoints now routed via westeurope fallback. Observed error rate returned to baseline.

Elena S: sent customer note to two impacted tenants (CS-4567, CS-8910) with SR links and mitigation summary.

Priya K: handing off to Jorge L for next shift. Handoff notes: cause = partner/ExpressRoute carrier dampening in uknorth; mitigation = smart-routing fallback to westeurope + cache pre-warm + temporary dedicated pool routing; follow-ups = net-eng action (Maria) to validate resilience, postmortem if SR confirms recurring maintenance.

Jorge L: ack taking over. I’ll keep the incident open for 2h and coordinate postmortem if Azure partner reports recurrence.

Alex P: :thumbsup: Great coordination. Create postmortem ticket when incident resolved.

Priya K: closing my active pager. Leaving runbook snippet in incident ticket: Steps executed, commands, SR# 987654321, partner contact, timestamps.

NOC Bot: incident state changed to MONITORING.

SRE Ops: note for post-incident: add probe from private-onprem runners to detect AS-level path increases >100ms for uknorth so we can auto-steer earlier.

Elena S: tagging net-eng (Maria) to follow up with partner escalation next business day if flaps resume.

Maria G: will collect BGP dump and coordinate with partner. Assigning to myself: NETENG-2026-112.

IncidentBot: thread closed for active mitigation at 03:32:25Z, status MONITORING.
